verdict.rationale: Windmill documents a public OpenAPI 3.0.3 "Windmill API" and its own programmatic deployment of flows via the wmill CLI and Git sync auto-deploy. However, the pack never shows specific API endpoints for creating, updating, or activating a flow, so the public-API part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit flow create/update endpoints in the API reference, documented activation/enable semantics, an agent-driven example, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create, update, and activate a workflow programmatically through the public API

citations.quote: Windmill's cloud instance serves its OpenAPI 3.0.3 document live at /api/openapi.json (info title "Windmill API")
as well as CLI deployments from a Git repository
Windmill can automatically deploy new commits from the repository into the workspace
